title: WFO Watersports Boat and Jet Ski Rentals Lake of the Ozarks
specs: Located at 17.5 Mile Marker in Backwater Jack’s Cove, near main channel
Designated boating boundaries include Shady Gators (7 Mile Marker), Margaritaville (26 Mile Marker), and Public Beach #1 (11.5 Mile Marker)
Primary renter must be at least 18 years old with valid driver’s license or government-issued photo ID
Boating Safety Identification Card required if born on or after January 1, 1984; temporary Missouri card available online
WaveRunner renters must be at least 21 years old with valid U.S. government-issued ID
Children 7 and under must wear U.S. Coast Guard-approved PFD at all times on board and dock
Boat capacity up to 13 passengers on select vessels; others per manufacturer limits
Renters can rent two boats for larger parties

blurb: Guests rent boats or personal watercraft to explore Lake of the Ozarks within designated boundaries. Rentals include safety equipment and a safety briefing. Pets are allowed with prior notice and responsibility for any damage.
